capabilities.name: Send an SDK request
capabilities.description: Use an existing SDK to submit a JSON request.
capabilities.whenToUse: An application needs the SDK's documented request operation.

usage.instructions: Install the actual SDK, create its client and follow its request contract.
usage.input: A JSON request accepted by the actual SDK.
examples: See the actual SDK request example.

capabilities.name: Call an existing tool
capabilities.description: Use a host tool to look up a record by its key.

usage.instructions: Discover the existing tool and pass its documented arguments.

capabilities.name: Follow a review skill
capabilities.description: Follow an existing host skill to review a change.

usage.instructions: Load the installed skill and follow its review steps; Graph does not install or execute it.

capabilities.name: Prepare a release workflow
capabilities.description: Prepare a release using the team's existing checks.

usage.instructions: Run the team's documented checks and obtain its release authorization.
